stable.description: Production-certified line. Installable into the active production slot.

candidate.description: Release candidate. Installable into an inactive slot and promotable to production after its gates pass; not yet the production line.

dev.description: Development build. May be installed only as an inactive candidate for testing; installing it as stable is refused at the installer ingress.

_commit: Filled at build time in the STAMPED copies this file's writer emits (packaged release-identity.json, doc banners). Null here: the hand-edited source never carries build output.
_generated_at: Filled at build time from the deterministic build clock (EXCEL_INFLOW_BUILD_TIMESTAMP / SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH / HEAD committer date), so a rebuild of one commit stays byte-identical.
